title: Starting state
note: Default golden capture and harness refresh share a UTC second timestamp name, <user>-home-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ, beside the current golden. Later same-day captures use new names; an exact current-golden collision refuses golden_capture_destination_collision and teaches retrying after the second changes or choosing an explicit destination. Explicit paths remain as given; a first capture requires one. Source supports an as_is continuity_fingerprint of stable regular files, checked under the lease before setup and again before mission walking; continuity_lost refuses without starting on missing, changed or uncheckable state. This detects loss between leases; it does not reserve the host. macOS restore retries a failed captured-entry copy once, preserves the existing reset boundary, and refuses persistent failure with its unrestored-entry receipt. Live proof remains pending.
